title: The logarithmic GCD kernel as certified divisor-feature geometry

published_claims.public_statement: For every finite family of positive natural numbers, the Gram quadratic form generated by K(m,n)=log(gcd(m,n)) is nonnegative.
The finitely supported divisor feature map phi(n)_d=sqrt(Lambda(d))[d divides n] has dot product log(gcd(m,n)) for nonzero natural inputs.

boundary_claims.public_effect: Do not describe the kernel as strictly positive definite on all positive natural numbers.
Do not claim mathematical novelty, theorem priority, or first-formalization priority.

permitted_description: A GCL-certified Lean formalization and explicit Finsupp realization of a classical GCD-matrix positivity criterion.
prohibited_descriptions: strictly positive definite on all positive natural numbers
